shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on stone surface
rectilinear blocks or panels of motifs
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry shallow curvilinear relief motifs including a prominent circular disc/ring and looping bands, which any relief tradition might produce independently. A is a dense, all-over composition of interlocking glyph-like blocks, scrolls and figural elements filling every part of the field, whereas B is a three-dimensional carved figure with a head and shoulders whose back bears only a few isolated, widely spaced motifs, so the subject matter, density and organisation are entirely different.
